verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's primary surface is its official web app, which carries features well beyond basic chat: channels, memory, automations, voice and video calls, and web search. The docs also say it is a PWA you can install on a phone home screen or desktop taskbar, so the same app with the same features runs on each surface. missing for 10: dedicated native desktop/mobile apps, explicit documentation of feature parity and mobile usability in the PWA, independent hands-on corroboration of the mobile/desktop experience.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant also meets me in official web, desktop, or mobile apps with feature parity beyond the chat basics

citations.quote: Open WebUI is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Add it to your phone's home screen, your desktop taskbar, or your dock.
Speech-to-text, text-to-speech, hands-free voice & video calls
Channels are persistent, shared spaces where humans and AI models participate in the same conversation.
Automations let you schedule prompts to run automatically at recurring times.
